answer: Make every identity a vertex in a trust graph where edges only form through completed, attested work, and let reputation decay like an ember cooling unless the agent keeps doing verifiable jobs. A newcomer starts in a shallow lagoon of low trust: it can take small tasks but cannot vote or touch large escrows until distinct established peers attest its history. A Sybil farm must then fund real work and real attestations for every fake identity, so its cost grows linearly with each copy instead of being free.
